rows.question: Find institutions from the region of Nordjylland
rows.pred_sql:
WITH institutions_core AS (
SELECT
  unics_id,
  institutions_name,
  acronym,
  short_name,
  country_id,
  geocode_regions_3,
  website,
  grid_id,
  wikidata_url,
  db_pedia_url
FROM institutions
),
institutions_with_country AS (
SELECT
  institutions.unics_id AS "institutions.unics_id",
  institutions.institutions_name AS "institutions.institutions_name",
  institutions.acronym AS "institutions.acronym",
  institutions.short_name AS "institutions.short_name",
  institutions.country_id AS "institutions.country_id",
  countries.country_name AS "countries.country_name",
  institutions.geocode_regions_3 AS "institutions.geocode_regions_3",
  institutions.website AS "institutions.website",
  institutions.grid_id AS "institutions.grid_id",
  institutions.wikidata_url AS "institutions.wikidata_url",
  institutions.db_pedia_url AS "institutions.db_pedia_url"
FROM institutions
LEFT JOIN countries
  ON institutions.country_id = countries.unics_id
),
institutions_region_codes_lookup AS (
SELECT
  geocode_regions_3,
  -- prefer a stored region_name if present; lift literal for NULL fallback out of view
  NULL::text AS region_name,
  -- prefer a stored region_code if present; lift literal for NULL fallback out of view
  NULL::text AS region_code
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT geocode_regions_3
  FROM institutions
  WHERE geocode_regions_3 IS NOT NULL
) t
)
SELECT
  ic.unics_id,
  ic.institutions_name,
  ic.acronym,
  ic.short_name,
  ic.country_id,
  ic.geocode_regions_3,
  ic.website,
  ic.grid_id,
  ic.wikidata_url,
  ic.db_pedia_url
FROM institutions_core ic
JOIN institutions_region_codes_lookup r
  ON ic.geocode_regions_3 = r.geocode_regions_3
WHERE r.region_name = 'Nordjylland'
ORDER BY ic.institutions_name

rows.question: Find the name of principal investigators in projects that started in 2014

  SELECT
    p.unics_id,
    p.acronym,
    p.title,
    p.start_date,
    p.end_date,
    p.start_year,
    p.end_year,
    p.principal_investigator
  FROM projects p
),
people_core AS (
  SELECT
    p.unics_id,
    p.full_name
  FROM people p
),
project_principal_investigator_link AS (
  SELECT
    pr.unics_id                                   AS project_unics_id,
    pr.acronym                                    AS project_acronym,
    pr.title                                      AS project_title,
    pr.start_date                                 AS project_start_date,
    pr.start_year                                 AS project_start_year,
    pe.unics_id                                   AS principal_investigator_unics_id,
    pe.full_name                                  AS principal_investigator_full_name

)

  project_principal_investigator_link.principal_investigator_full_name AS full_name
FROM project_principal_investigator_link
WHERE project_principal_investigator_link.project_start_year = 2014

rows.question: Find distinct titles of topics of projects that with end year 2014
rows.pred_sql:
WITH projects_core AS (
  SELECT
    p.unics_id,
    p.acronym,
    p.title,
    p.start_date,
    p.end_date,
    COALESCE(p.start_year, CASE WHEN p.start_date IS NOT NULL THEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.start_date)::integer ELSE NULL END) AS start_year,
    COALESCE(p.end_year, CASE WHEN p.end_date IS NOT NULL THEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.end_date)::integer ELSE NULL END) AS end_year,
    p.ec_call,
    p.ec_fund_scheme,
    p.framework_program,
    p.principal_investigator
  FROM projects p
),
topics_dim AS (
  SELECT
    t.code AS code,
    t.title AS title,
    t.rcn AS rcn
  FROM topics t
),
project_to_topics AS (
  SELECT
    pt.project AS project,
    pt.topic AS topic
  FROM project_topics pt
)
SELECT DISTINCT t.title
FROM projects_core p
JOIN project_to_topics pt ON p.unics_id = pt.project
JOIN topics_dim t ON pt.topic = t.code
WHERE p.end_year = 2014

rows.question: Find the code and title of the funding scheme which funded the highest number of projects.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH projects_row_level AS (
  SELECT
    unics_id,
    ec_fund_scheme,
    acronym,
    title,
    start_year,
    end_year
  FROM projects
),
funding_schemes_dim AS (
  SELECT
    code,
    title
  FROM funding_schemes
),
projects_count_by_funding_scheme AS (
  SELECT
    fs.code AS ec_fund_scheme,
    COUNT(prl.unics_id) AS project_count
  FROM funding_schemes_dim fs
  LEFT JOIN projects_row_level prl
    ON prl.ec_fund_scheme = fs.code
  GROUP BY
    fs.code
)
SELECT f.code,
       f.title
FROM projects_count_by_funding_scheme p
JOIN funding_schemes_dim f
  ON p.ec_fund_scheme = f.code
WHERE p.ec_fund_scheme IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY p.project_count DESC
LIMIT 1

rows.question: Find the projects which lasted the longest and have an end year and a start year
rows.pred_sql:
WITH projects_with_years AS (
  SELECT
    p.unics_id,
    p.acronym,
    p.title,
    p.start_year,
    p.end_year
  FROM projects p
  WHERE p.start_year IS NOT NULL
    AND p.end_year IS NOT NULL
),
projects_duration AS (
  SELECT
    unics_id,
    acronym,
    title,
    start_year,
    end_year,
    -- duration in years (inclusive)
    (end_year - start_year + 1) AS duration_years
  FROM projects_with_years
)
SELECT
  unics_id,
  acronym,
  title,
  start_year,
  end_year,
  duration_years
FROM projects_duration
WHERE duration_years = (
  SELECT MAX(duration_years) FROM projects_duration
)
ORDER BY duration_years DESC

rows.question: Show me the country name of all institutes.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH institutions_base AS (
  SELECT
    unics_id,
    NULLIF(trim(institutions_name), '') AS institutions_name,
    country_id,
    NULLIF(trim(geocode_regions_3), '') AS geocode_regions_3,
    NULLIF(NULLIF(trim(acronym), ''), '(null)') AS acronym,
    NULLIF(trim(short_name), '') AS short_name,
    NULLIF(NULLIF(trim(website), ''), '(null)') AS website
  FROM institutions
),
countries_key AS (
  SELECT
    unics_id,
    country_name,
    country_code2,
    country_code3,
    geocode_country_code
  FROM countries
),
institutions_with_country AS (
  SELECT
    i.unics_id                              AS institutions_unics_id,
    i.institutions_name                     AS institutions_institutions_name,
    i.acronym                               AS institutions_acronym,
    i.short_name                            AS institutions_short_name,
    i.website                               AS institutions_website,
    i.country_id                            AS institutions_country_id,
    c.unics_id                              AS countries_unics_id,
    c.country_name                          AS countries_country_name,
    c.country_code2                         AS countries_country_code2,
    c.country_code3                         AS countries_country_code3
  FROM institutions_base i
  JOIN countries_key c
    ON i.country_id = c.unics_id
)
SELECT
  institutions_unics_id AS institution_unics_id,
  institutions_institutions_name AS institution_name,
  countries_country_name AS country_name
FROM institutions_with_country
